extra.text: Darklings gather below the last safe lamps. Kill three hostile specimens and submit the field note at any village.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Stay underground, keep a retreat lit, and count the eyes before the teeth.

decline.text: Then close the book for tonight. Good fieldwork begins with consent.

in_progress.text: These are cave threats, not tameable companions. Record where the light failed.

ready.text: Three Darklings ended and the margin filled? Any village may archive it.

extra.text: The page now warns plainly: the dark below has teeth.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
